**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Sparkling:

- **§ 3 / paragraph (g)** — the only restraints on Sparkling are ordinary licence-scope limits (no copying except backups, no reverse engineering, no sublicence/transfer, no service-bureau use of the Work). None restricts what businesses Sparkling may run or what products it may buy or build.
- **§ 2** — the licence is expressly "non-transferable and non-exclusive"; no exclusivity or sourcing commitment.
- **§ 19** — mutual employee non-solicitation, which belongs under the non-solicitation rule, not here; not flagged twice.
- **§ 20 / general matters and schedules** — no territory, competing-product, or field-of-use covenant.

No redline proposed.
